en.headline: Lo says work on a New Territories North hospital cluster starts next year
en.dek: The health secretary told LegCo the Hospital Authority would begin preparing a New Territories North cluster in 2027 to match Northern Metropolis growth.
body: The Hospital Authority will begin preparatory work next year on a New Territories North hospital cluster, Secretary for Health Lo Chung-mau said on Friday, tying the plan to development of the Northern Metropolis.

Speaking in a joint Legislative Council debate on Hong Kong's first five-year plan and the Policy Address, Lo said the government would press ahead with the Ngau Tam Mei integrated medical teaching and research hospital and assess whether a hospital in Hung Shui Kiu is needed and feasible. He said the 16 projects in the first hospital development plan were expected to be completed in 2031, and that the current term would announce a second plan.

Lo also set out wider primary-care plans. He said the government would legislate to set service standards and a register of providers, and aim within five years to largely complete District Health Centres across all 18 districts. Membership of those centres was targeted at one million, he said, with primary-care resources about 30 per cent above the current level. Community pharmacy services and more family-medicine clinic places were also planned.

Queen Elizabeth Hospital would be developed as the city's first integrated day hospital, he said, with high-throughput centres for cataract surgery, radiology and radiotherapy to open in the coming financial year. Stable new-case waiting times at seven designated specialist outpatient clinics were to be cut by one year within five years, he said. Cancer diagnosis and treatment would be strengthened, and public hospital fee reform used to give more patients faster access to newer drugs.

zh.headline: 盧寵茂：明年起籌建新界北醫院聯網
zh.dek: 醫務衞生局局長表示，為配合北部都會區，明年起會開展籌建新界北聯網，並評估洪水橋醫院的需要。
body: 醫務衞生局局長盧寵茂周五表示，為配合北部都會區發展，明年起會開展籌建新界北醫院聯網，推進牛潭尾綜合醫教研醫院建設，並評估興建洪水橋醫院的需要和可行性。
盧寵茂在立法會合併辯論《香港第一個五年規劃》及《施政報告》時說，第一個醫院發展計劃的16個項目預計2031年落成，本屆政府亦會在今個任期內公布第二個醫院發展計劃，並有序推展。
他同時談到基層醫療。盧寵茂說，政府會立法賦權訂立服務標準和服務提供者名冊，並協同發展地區康健網絡，力爭五年內基本完成18區地區康健中心建設。目標是地區康健中心會員達100萬人，基層醫療健康服務資源較現時增加三成，並會開展社區藥房計劃及增加家庭醫學門診名額。
他又說，伊利沙伯醫院將發展為全港首間綜合日間醫院，下年度首推高流量白內障手術中心、高流量放射診斷中心和放射治療中心。計劃在五年內將七個指定專科門診的穩定新症輪候時間縮短一年，並加強癌症診斷和治療。透過公營醫療收費改革，他說，希望讓更多市民更快用上更多先進新藥。
